label: the duplicate check is dropped, so a retried merge counts the same PR twice
the PR is matched as a substring, so an existing #900 swallows a record for #90
an empty or '?' sha is accepted, so a delivery row lands with no commit to audit
a failed append still prints recorded and exits zero, so a delivery is claimed that never reached the log
old:
if ! printf '%s PR #%s %s %s merged %s %s\n' "$(date '+%F %H:%M')" "$PR" "$SLUG" "$ITEM" "$SHORT" "$URL" >> "$LOG"; then
  echo "record-merged: append to $LOG failed" >&2
  exit 1
fi

label: the merge-success path skips the writer, so a merged PR reports RECORDED with no row
the dispatcher never drains a queued delivery, so a transient SHA failure loses the row forever
the new suite is not wired into job_shell_test, so it never runs in a gate or in CI
